page.title: Admin
page.subtitle: Manage games, sync card data, and the card image vector database

board.heading: Board
board.description: Connect a kit board and flash firmware if it's new. Connecting here skips the automatic self-test, so a bare board with nothing plugged in still works.

servos.heading: Servo bench
servos.description: Plug a servo into a channel, run it through its range, then mark it as passed or failed. Center puts it in the middle of its range, ready for fitting the horn.
servos.centerHint: Center is pulse {{pulse}}. Release cuts power so the servo can be turned by hand.

stress.heading: Stress test
stress.description: Cycle servos between min and max nonstop to find out how long they last. Point a webcam at the servos and the test spots the ones that stop moving, or watch them yourself and mark each one when it stops.
stress.hint: Pick one or more channels. The test ends when every servo is marked, when you press Stop, or when the board stops answering. Stopped servos are released at once.

endReason.allServosStopped: Every servo stopped. The test ran for {{elapsed}}.
endReason.boardStopped: The board stopped answering after {{elapsed}}. Check its power and connection.

camera.heading: Watch with a camera
camera.description: Fix a webcam so it sees the servo horns, then draw a box around each horn. The first cycle learns what changes when each servo moves. After that, a servo whose box stops changing for 3 moves in a row is marked stopped. Slow changes in light are followed as the test runs.
camera.startFailed: The camera didn't start. Check that it's plugged in, not used by another app, and that the browser may use it.
camera.pickChannels: Pick the channels to test above, then draw a box for each.
camera.editorLabel: Camera preview, drawing the box for channel {{channel}}
camera.editorHint: Drag on the preview to draw a box around the horn, or use the buttons to place and size it. Channels without a box are watched by you.

status.noMotion: Camera can't see this servo move. Make the horn easier to see or watch it yourself.

camera.announceStopped: The camera saw the servo on channel {{channel}} stop moving.
camera.adjustLabel: Move or resize the box for channel {{channel}}

stress.calibrationHint: Module servos move between their calibrated positions for this sorter, and the other channels use the full range. A module's side paddle and pusher can't run together, because the firmware lowers the paddle before every pusher move.
stress.calibrationHintWithFeeder: Module servos move between their calibrated positions for this sorter, and the other channels use the full range. A module's side paddle and pusher can't run together, because the firmware lowers the paddle before every pusher move. Channel {{channel}} is the feeder, which spins instead of holding a position, so it can't be stress tested.
stress.defaultCalibration: No sorter is saved for this board, so module servos use the default calibration. Calibrate the sorter first if its linkages are fitted.

leds.heading: LED strips
leds.description: Two 8-LED RGBW strips on GPIO 14. Pick an LED to switch it on or off and set its red, green, blue and white levels and brightness, or switch a whole strip at once.
leds.needsFirmware: LED strips need firmware {{version}} or newer. Flash the board to use them.

status.busy: The board is busy with another command.

toasts.commandFailed: The board didn't accept the command

rawCommands.heading: Raw commands
rawCommands.description: Send any JSON command straight to the board, one line at a time. Raw pulses skip calibration, so start near the center and watch the linkage. Stop all cuts power to every servo; send Neutral to recover.
rawCommands.commandHint: One JSON object, for example {"servo": "pusher", "module": 1, "value": 305}. Pulses run from 120 to 490. See firmware/PROTOCOL.md for every command.

cardImageVectors.heading: Card Image Vectors
cardImageVectors.concurrencyDescription: Vectorizes this many card images at once. Downloads still start a short time apart.
cardImageVectors.browserStoppedHint: The browser could not run the image model. Reload this page before trying again. Saved cards are kept.
cardImageVectors.browserWorking: This computer is vectorizing up to {{count}} cards at a time. Keep this page open.

syncCardById.heading: Sync Card by ID
syncCardById.description: Fetch and vectorize a single card, adding it if it isn't in the database yet

syncApiKeys.heading: Sync API keys
syncApiKeys.description: Keys that let scripts and schedulers start card database syncs without signing in. Each key only does what its permissions allow.
syncApiKeys.createDescription: Pick what this key may do. You can't change permissions later, so revoke and recreate the key instead.

sync_start.label: Start sync
sync_start.description: Start a regular sync of a game. Unchanged cards are skipped.

sync_force.label: Force resync
sync_force.description: Start a sync that downloads and re-vectorizes every card, even unchanged ones.

sync_card.label: Sync single cards
sync_card.description: Fetch and vectorize one card by its ID.

sync_cancel.label: Cancel sync
sync_cancel.description: Stop the sync that is running.

syncApiKeys.createFailed: Couldn't create the sync API key.
syncApiKeys.revokeFailed: Couldn't revoke the sync API key.
syncApiKeys.revokeConfirmDescription: Anything using this key stops working right away. This can't be undone.
syncApiKeys.revealDescription: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it somewhere safe.

dumpDatabase.heading: Dump Card Database
dumpDatabase.description: Permanently delete card image vectors, for one game or all of them
dumpDatabase.confirmAll: This will permanently delete all card image vectors and cannot be undone. Are you sure?
dumpDatabase.confirmScoped: This will permanently delete all "{{scope}}" card image vectors and cannot be undone. Are you sure?

impersonationUsersManager.heading: Impersonate User
impersonationUsersManager.description: Search for a user to view the app as them, for support/debugging
impersonationUsersManager.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or organization...
impersonationUsersManager.startTyping: Start typing a name, email or organization to search

confirmDialog.title: Impersonate this user?
confirmDialog.description: You'll see the app exactly as {{email}} does, including their organizations and data. This is logged. You can exit impersonation at any time from the banner at the top of the screen.

subscriptionSummary.heading: Subscriptions
subscriptionSummary.description: Organizations with a paid subscription, by plan. Monthly recurring revenue uses each plan's list price, with yearly plans spread over 12 months, before discounts and taxes. Trials count as subscribers but add no revenue.
subscriptionSummary.unpriced_one: {{count}} subscriber's price couldn't be loaded from Stripe, so they're left out of revenue.
subscriptionSummary.unpriced_other: {{count}} subscribers' prices couldn't be loaded from Stripe, so they're left out of revenue.

metricsStats.heading: Scan stats
metricsStats.description: App-wide scan activity across every organization, and whether each scan was vectorized on the server or in the browser. Someone counts as actively scanning while they've saved a scan in the last {{minutes}} minutes.

activeScanSessions.title: Active scan sessions
activeScanSessions.emptyDescription: Sessions appear here while a collection is locked for scanning.

errorReportingTest.heading: Test Better Stack
errorReportingTest.description: Send a test error to Better Stack from the client and/or the server to confirm error reporting is wired up

toasts.clientSent: Sent test error to Better Stack (client).
toasts.serverError: Failed to send test error to Better Stack (server)

plans.featuresDescription: Which plans can use each feature. Features are defined in code, so a new one shows up here once it's built.
plans.limitsDescription: How much of each thing an organization on each plan can have. Turn on Unlimited to remove a limit.
plans.billingDisabled: Billing is turned off on this server, so every organization gets every feature with no limits. These settings take effect once billing is on.

validation.number: Enter a whole number, 0 or more

chaosSort.label: Chaos sort
chaosSort.description: Fill bins in order, ignoring rules. Turning it off only stops new presets from switching it on.

storage.label: Storage locations
storage.description: Create locations and record bins into them. Existing locations stay viewable either way.

apiAccess.label: API access
apiAccess.description: Create organization API keys and read cards and storage locations through the public API. Revoking existing keys always works.

businessTools.label: Buy and sell
businessTools.description: Intake lots with buylist offers, order import and fulfilment, cost and margin reports, and spot checks. Existing records stay viewable either way.

repacks.label: Repacks
repacks.description: Build repacks from bin slots. Turning it off only stops presets from switching it on. Presets that already build repacks keep working.

customSounds.label: Custom sounds
customSounds.description: Upload custom sound clips for sound rules. Turning it off only stops new uploads. Clips already uploaded keep playing.

fleetHealth.label: Fleet health
fleetHealth.description: The sorter health panel on the Sorters page: status, cards since service, alert history and service intervals. Jam and offline alerts are still recorded and sent either way.

longShareLinks.label: Longer monitor links
longShareLinks.description: Monitor links can last any of the day lengths set on the web in Admin > Share links. Without it they use the short length set there.

dailyScans.label: Daily scans
dailyScans.description: Cards scanned per organization per UTC day.

connectedSorters.label: Connected sorters
connectedSorters.description: Sorters connected at once. Every plan is also capped at the server's hard maximum.

soundRules.label: Sound rules
soundRules.description: Sound rules across all games. Only checked when adding a rule.

notificationRules.label: Notification rules
notificationRules.description: Discord notification rules across all games. Only checked when adding a rule.

organizations.label: Owned organizations
organizations.description: Organizations a user may own. Checked in the app against the plan of the organization the user has open when creating a new one.

membersPerOrg.label: Members per organization
membersPerOrg.description: Members per organization, counted owners first, then by join date. Members past the limit are locked out until the plan is upgraded or members are removed.

collections.label: Collections
collections.description: Collections per organization. Only checked when creating a collection.

preview.heading: Preview a plan
preview.description: See the app as an organization on another plan would: limits, locked features and the billing page all follow the plan you pick. Only affects your own requests on this browser.

legacy.description: Only Free and the original Business plan are on sale, at the legacy Business prices. New Business subscribers get the legacy Business tier.
legacy.confirmDescription: Enthusiast and the new Business plan go on sale right away, using the STRIPE_PRICE_ID_ENTHUSIAST and STRIPE_PRICE_ID_BUSINESS prices. Current Business subscribers keep their plan and start seeing it labelled as legacy.

tiered.description: Free, Enthusiast and Business are on sale. Existing subscribers to the original Business plan keep it as the legacy tier.
tiered.confirmTitle: Switch back to the old pricing?
tiered.confirmDescription: Enthusiast and the new Business plan stop being sold, and Business checkout goes back to the legacy prices. People who already subscribed to a new plan keep it.

deletedItems.heading: Deleted items
deletedItems.description: Everything deleted in any organization, except scanned cards. Restoring puts an item back exactly as it was.

platformStats.statsDescription: Which numbers to include in each post, across every organization.

scannedCards.label: Scanned cards
scannedCards.description: Every scan ever saved, matched or not. Deleting cards doesn't lower it.

scansLast24Hours.label: Scans in the last 24 hours
scansLast24Hours.description: Scans saved in the 24 hours before the post.

devices.label: Calibrated devices
devices.description: Calibrated sorters: at least one module saved with servo values other than the defaults. Deleted ones are excluded.

collections.label: Collections
collections.description: Collections across every organization, excluding deleted ones.

platformStats.scheduleDescription: Posts are sent when this command runs. Add it as a scheduled task in Coolify on the server app, with whatever cron you want.

discordChannels.botUnreachable: The Discord bot isn't reachable, so servers and channels can't be listed right now.

stats.heading: Platform stats
stats.description: Where the platform stats are posted, and which numbers each post includes. Leave the channel empty to stop posting stats.

donations.heading: Donations
donations.description: Where each Buy Me a Coffee donation is posted. Leave it empty to stop posting donations.

pricing.heading: Price updates
pricing.description: Where a summary is posted whenever the price sync pulls new prices. Leave it empty to stop posting price updates.

discordChannels.priceSyncCommand: Prices are pulled when this command runs. Add it as a scheduled task in Coolify on the server app, every few hours. It only downloads what changed upstream.
discordChannels.donationsLink: Open the Buy Me a Coffee page

linkedRole.heading: Linked account role
linkedRole.description: Members of this server who link their Mault account with /link-account get this role, and lose it when they unlink. The bot needs Manage Roles, and its own role must sit above this one.
linkedRole.saveFailed: Couldn't save the linked account role.

systemSoundClips.heading: System sound clips
systemSoundClips.description: Clips every organization can use in its sound rules. Organizations can play them but can't rename or delete them.

apiUsage.heading: API usage
apiUsage.description: Requests per API key and per public route, so you can spot polling. Counts are written about once a minute while the database is awake, so the newest requests can take a little while to show.
apiUsage.emptyApiKeys: No API key requests in this period.
apiUsage.emptyPublicRoutes: No public route requests in this period.

shortLinks.heading: Custom short links
shortLinks.description: Short links on your short link domain that redirect anywhere, such as a Discord invite or a promo page.
shortLinks.dialogDescription: People who open the short link are sent to the destination.
shortLinks.saveFailed: Couldn't save the short link. Try again.
shortLinks.disabledDescription: Set SHORT_LINK_BASE_URL on the API and run the shortener service to create custom short links.
shortLinks.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
shortLinks.deleteConfirmDescription: {{url}} will stop working for everyone who has it. This can't be undone.
shortLinks.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the short link. Try again.

failures.disabled: Short links are off on this server.
failures.codeTaken: That code is already in use. Pick another.
failures.notFound: That short link no longer exists.

shareLinkLengths.heading: Share link lengths
shareLinkLengths.description: How long new monitor and trade links last. A shorter length also cuts links that are already shared. A longer one applies to links made after you save.
shareLinkLengths.saveFailed: Couldn't save the share link lengths.
shareLinkLengths.loadFailed: Couldn't load the share link lengths.

tradeLinkHours.label: Trade links (hours)
tradeLinkHours.description: Every trade link lasts this long. Up to {{max}} hours.

restrictedShareLinkHours.label: Monitor links without longer links (hours)
restrictedShareLinkHours.description: How long monitor links last on plans without longer monitor links. Up to {{max}} hours.

monitorLinkExpiryDays.label: Monitor link choices (days)
monitorLinkExpiryDays.description: The lengths plans with longer monitor links can pick from, separated by commas. Up to {{maxOptions}} choices of 1 to {{maxDays}} days. The longest one also caps links already shared.

featureHighlights.heading: What's new
featureHighlights.description: Feature highlights shown to every user after sign-in, in a card on desktop and a sheet on phones. Release highlights ship with the app and don't appear here.

form.description: Each slide shows media, a title, text and an optional link.
form.publishHint: Users see a published highlight from its publish date until it is older than 45 days.
form.title: Title
form.mediaUrlHint: Upload a file or paste a hosted https:// URL.

toasts.unsupportedFile: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4 or WebM file.

deleteDialog.title: Delete highlight?
deleteDialog.description: Users stop seeing it. You can restore it from Deleted items.
